## What lands

- **The sweep (SIG-UI-075).** Every counted root-absolute path site in `web/src/**` routes through the helper: in-site links → `withBase()`; the SIG-REL-008 exception namespaces (`/r/`, `/releases/`, the live `/v1/` API, `/intake/`) → the new `rootPath()`; artifact-data paths (`documentUrl` fields) → the new `dataHref()` (in-site values re-base, exceptions pass raw). Page canonical + print canonical/printUrl → `withBase`; `describedby` → the immutable `/releases/<pub>/release.json`.
- **The deploy seam.** `astro.config.mjs` reads `SIG_BASE_PATH` → `base` — the same build re-bases under `/s/<pub>/` for the snapshot machinery (P36.66b); default `/` is byte-identical to today.
- **The mount check.** `check-snapshot-mount.mjs` (wired into `npm run check` as `check:snapshot`) builds the fixture tree under `SIG_BASE_PATH=/s/p-<64hex>` and scans every emitted `href`/`src`/`action`/`poster`: root-absolute links must stay inside the base or name a declared exception; absolute same-origin URLs must be in-base, an exception, or the declared `as_of_` selector form. 430 pages / 51,812 attrs — clean.
- **The baseline to zero.** `root-absolute-paths-baseline.json` re-measured: **0 counted sites** (281 raw, all 220 exempted with recorded reasons — canonical path props, JSON pointers, route-id constants, fixture artifact data). Any new un-classed literal now fails `check:paths`.
- **The citation block + release id + interim wording** stays verbatim on every page (P35.42's J3 §8.2 contract); under the snapshot base the default `recordPath = withBase(path)` resolves immutable `/s/<pub>/…`, so the block flips to the citable wording with no template edits.
